description: Answers 'how are traders positioned in this market?' Give a market (for example GOLD or CRUDE_OIL) and a start date; optionally end. Returns CFTC Commitments of Traders rows - managed money, producers, swap dealers, leveraged funds and asset managers, long/short/net - clipped to as_of, up to 5,000 rows per page. Covers CFTC COT since 1986. Free keys get the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_cot
title: Get COT
